name: social-pivot-root
description: Root entry point for Social Pivot project

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix social-main/Social-Pivot-main/backend && npm install --prefix social-main/Social-Pivot-main/frontend
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:dev --prefix social-main/Social-Pivot-main/backend" "npm run dev --prefix social-main/Social-Pivot-main/frontend"
